indexSpaces.decisionCursor: barIndex or currentRawBarIndex; never a structural sequence index

indexValueInvariant: Structural indices are non-negative integers and are rejected, never truncated, when fractional; only an empty snapshot cursor may be -1.

normalizedK.confirmation: same update under the current closed-bar policy

fractal.event: middle normalized K geometric source end
fractal.confirmation: first update where the right normalized K completes the strict guard

stroke.confirmation: first update where the stroke endpoint rule and spacing guard hold

rawFeatureElement.structuralIndex: raw feature sequence index plus source stroke index

standardizedFeatureElement.event: latest geometric source end represented by the sealed aggregate
standardizedFeatureElement.availability: non-including successor that seals the aggregate

featureFractal.event: middle standardized feature geometric source end
featureFractal.confirmation: right stable standardized feature availability where the full strict guard first holds
featureFractal.structuralIndex: eventFeatureIndex is middle; confirmFeatureIndex is right

case1Segment.confirmation: first causal decision time where all Case-1 guards hold
case1Segment.structuralIndex: raw-bar and stroke coordinates are explicit

structuralEvent.caseSpecificMeaning: stored in metadata (for example metadata.caseType=CASE_1), not encoded as a second eventAction vocabulary
